englishTests.name: IELTS
englishTests.overview: The most widely accepted English test for Australian skilled visas. Four skills assessed separately — all four bands must individually meet the minimum, no averaging allowed.

proficiency.label: Competent
proficiency.description: Minimum for most skilled & employer visas

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Independent
notes: All 4 bands must individually meet 6.0 — no averaging
Proficient (7.0) earns +10 pts in EOI
Superior (8.0) earns +20 pts in EOI

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Nominated
notes: Same band rule as 189 — no averaging
State may require higher English for nomination

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Work Regional
notes: Same as 189/190 minimum
Regional sponsor may impose higher requirements

visaRequirements.name: Skills in Demand Visa (Subclass 482)
notes: Short-term stream: 5.0 avg, no band below 4.5
Core Skills & Specialist streams: Competent (6.0 each)

visaRequirements.name: Employer Nominated (ENS)
notes: Direct Entry stream: 6.0 in each band
Result must be no more than 3 years old

visaRequirements.name: Temporary Graduate
notes: For IELTS Academic or General Training
Test must be taken in the 12 months before application

visaRequirements.name: Partner Visa
notes: Functional English or pay language fee (BIIP)
Sponsor may waive in some circumstances

visaRequirements.name: Student Visa
notes: University degrees: typically IELTS 6.0–6.5
TAFE/VET: typically 5.5
English schools: typically 4.5–5.5

centers.label: British Council Australia
centers.sublabel: Co-owner of IELTS · centres in major cities

englishTests.name: PTE
englishTests.validity: No official expiry (DHA accepts up to 3 years)
englishTests.overview: Fully computer-based and AI-scored. Fast results (usually 48 hrs). Accepted by all Australian skilled visa types. Each of the four communicative skills must individually meet the minimum.

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Independent
notes: All 4 skills must individually reach 50 — no averaging
Proficient (65) earns +10 pts; Superior (79) earns +20 pts

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Nominated
notes: Same as 189 — each skill must individually reach 50
State nomination may require higher scores

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Work Regional
notes: Same as 189/190 minimum
Regional sponsor may require higher scores

visaRequirements.name: Skills in Demand Visa (Subclass 482)
notes: Short-term stream: 36 in each skill
Core Skills & Specialist streams: 50 in each skill

visaRequirements.name: Employer Nominated (ENS)
notes: 50 in each communicative skill
Results accepted up to 3 years from application date

visaRequirements.name: Temporary Graduate
notes: For tests taken on or after 7 August 2025
Earlier tests: 57 overall · 43 L · 48 R · 51 W · 42 S; test must be within 12 months

visaRequirements.name: Student Visa
notes: Minimum set by education provider, not DHA
Most universities: equivalent to IELTS 6.0–6.5

centers.label: Pearson PTE — Book a Test
centers.sublabel: Computer-based · centres in all major Australian cities

englishTests.full: Test of English as a Foreign Language – Internet-Based
englishTests.overview: Accepted only when taken at an approved test centre. Tests from 26 July 2023 to 4 May 2024 were not approved. For tests from 7 August 2025, select “Taking TOEFL for Australia” when registering. TOEFL iBT Home Edition is not accepted.

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Nominated

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Work Regional
notes: Current thresholds apply to tests from 7 August 2025

visaRequirements.name: Skills in Demand Visa (Subclass 482)
notes: For Core and Specialist Skills tests from 13 September 2025

visaRequirements.name: Employer Nominated (ENS)
notes: Current thresholds apply to tests from 7 August 2025

visaRequirements.name: Temporary Graduate

englishTests.name: Cambridge C1
englishTests.overview: Globally recognised academic English certificate. Cambridge Scale scores map to CEFR levels. Each component must individually meet the minimum — no overall average accepted by DHA.

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Independent
notes: Each component (L, R, W, S, Use of English) must reach 169
Proficient (185) earns +10 pts; Superior (200) earns +20 pts

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Nominated
notes: Same as 189 — each component individually
State/territory nomination may set higher requirement

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Work Regional
notes: Same as 189/190 minimum per component
Regional sponsor may require higher scores

visaRequirements.name: Skills in Demand Visa (Subclass 482)
notes: Short-term stream: 154 each component
Core Skills & Specialist streams: 169 each component

visaRequirements.name: Employer Nominated (ENS)
notes: Each component must meet 169 individually
Cambridge results do not have an expiry date

visaRequirements.name: Temporary Graduate
notes: Waived if 2+ years of Australian study completed
Test must be within 3 years of application

englishTests.name: CELPIP
englishTests.full: Canadian English Language Proficiency Index Program
englishTests.scoreRange: Level 1–9 per skill (R · W · L · S)
englishTests.overview: Computer-based English test accepted by DHA for Australian skilled visas. CELPIP scores each of the four communicative skills separately — all must individually meet the minimum. Note: CELPIP does not qualify for Superior English (+20 pts) bonus.

proficiency.label: Superior
proficiency.description: CELPIP does not qualify for Superior English level

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Independent
notes: All 4 skills must individually reach Level 7 — no averaging
Proficient (8) earns +10 pts; Superior NOT available via CELPIP

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Nominated
notes: Same as 189 — each skill must individually reach 7
State nomination may require higher scores

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Work Regional
notes: Same as 189/190 minimum per skill
Regional sponsor may require higher scores

visaRequirements.name: Skills in Demand Visa (Subclass 482)
notes: Short-term stream: 4 in each skill
Core Skills & Specialist streams: 7 in each skill

visaRequirements.name: Employer Nominated (ENS)
notes: Each skill must individually meet 7
Results must not be more than 2 years old at time of application

visaRequirements.name: Temporary Graduate
notes: Waived if 2+ years of Australian study completed
Test must be within 2 years of application

englishTests.name: OET
englishTests.overview: Developed for health professionals and accepted by DHA for visa English evidence. Tests taken from 7 August 2025 use numeric component scores; earlier valid results use letter grades.

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Nominated

visaRequirements.name: Skilled Work Regional
notes: Current thresholds apply to tests from 7 August 2025

visaRequirements.name: Skills in Demand Visa (Subclass 482)
notes: For Core and Specialist Skills tests from 13 September 2025

notes: Current thresholds apply to tests from 7 August 2025

visaProcessingTimes.name: Visitor

Sufficient funds to support stay

visaProcessingTimes.name: Aged Parent
conditions: Must be of retirement age
Must be in Australia when you apply

visaProcessingTimes.name: Contributory Aged Parent

steps.title: English Language Test
steps.description: Take an approved in-person English test. Minimum: Competent (IELTS 6.0 each band). Proficient (+10 pts) and Superior (+20 pts) earn EOI bonus points. Since 7 Aug 2025, only in-person tests are accepted — Home/Online editions are NOT valid.
steps.duration: 2-4 weeks (results: PTE 2-5 days, IELTS 13 days, TOEFL 4-8 days)
documents: Test results valid up to 3 years
tips: Accepted tests: IELTS Academic, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT (in-person only), Cambridge C1 Advanced

OET is ONLY accepted for 12 healthcare professions: Dentistry, Dietetics, Medicine, Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Podiatry, Radiography, Speech Pathology, Veterinary Science
Competent: IELTS 6.0 each / PTE 50 each / TOEFL 16L·16R·19W·19S / Cambridge 169
Proficient (+10 pts): IELTS 7.0 each / PTE 65 each / TOEFL 22L·22R·26W·24S / Cambridge 185
Superior (+20 pts): IELTS 8.0 each / PTE 79 each / TOEFL 26L·27R·30W·28S / Cambridge 200
PTE often has fastest results (2-5 days) — popular choice for quick turnaround
TOEFL iBT Home Edition and IELTS Online are NOT accepted since 7 Aug 2025

assisting with loading and transporting logs
planning the felling of trees and determining the natural and intended fall of each tree
clearing surrounding area of saplings and debris prior to tree-felling
operating and maintaining manual and machine saws to fell trees and to cut felled trees into logs
